articles.title: Astronauts Return to Earth After 237 Days and 100 Million Miles in Space
articles.summary: NASA's Crew-12 astronauts splashed down safely after 237 days on the space station, where they ran experiments to help future Moon and Mars missions.

articles.title: Fossils Show an Early Human Relative Lived in Africa Earlier Than Thought
articles.summary: Fossils from a South African cave suggest Homo erectus lived there about 2 million years ago, around 200,000 years earlier than long believed.

articles.title: Bright Yellow 'Golden Tree' Coral Is So Strange It Needed a New Family
articles.summary: Scientists found a bright yellow, tree-shaped coral off Costa Rica so unusual that they created a new coral family and gave it an Elvish name meaning golden tree.
